title: Scalability
description: The system must be able to accommodate a large number of users and adapt to changing demands.

title: Usability
description: The system must be user-friendly and accessible to individuals with Dyslexia.

title: Performance
description: The system must be able to process user data efficiently and provide timely responses.

title: Security
description: The system must ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of user data.

title: Accessibility
description: The system must be accessible to users with disabilities and follow accessibility guidelines.

title: Data Privacy
description: The system must comply with data privacy regulations and ensure the secure storage and processing of user data.

title: Interoperability
description: The system must be able to integrate with other systems and tools to provide a seamless user experience.

title: Reliability
description: The system must be able to operate reliably and consistently, with minimal downtime.
